eligibility_record.evaluation_purpose: Determine whether CHR-2026-0001 may participate as governed evidence concerning the historical occurrence, temporal context, provenance, and institutional relationships associated with the 2026-07-05 issuance of SC-CERT-2026-0001.
eligibility_record.scope: Evidence within the Satoshium Chronicle institutional domain concerning preservation of the 2026-07-05 certification occurrence; identification of Satoshium Certifier as originating system; identity of SC-CERT-2026-0001; identity of the Atlas Certification Subject; distinction between occurrence date and later Chronicle creation/publication; Chronicle-preserved provenance; Chronicle relationships with Certifier, Atlas, and Registry; and institutional authority boundaries.
basis_references: CHR-2026-0001 — canonical Satoshium Chronicle Entry, version 1
SC-CERT-2026-0001 — canonical Satoshium Certifier Certification Package, version 1.1
Satoshium Attestor Rules — authority, provenance, scope, evidence-context, traceability, bounded-truth, independent-evaluation, uncertainty, and interoperability controls
eligibility_record.relevant_time_or_state: Certification occurrence: 2026-07-05. Certification Package hardening: 2026-07-17. Registry relationship: 2026-08-02. Chronicle Entry creation, Verification, Validation, and publication: 2026-08-22. Attestor production evaluation context: 2026-09-19. The certification occurrence date remains distinct from Chronicle canonical-creation and publication dates.
limitations: Chronicle preserves the historical representation of the occurrence; it does not perform or replace Satoshium Certifier's certification.
Chronicle Verification applies to Chronicle's representation of the historical occurrence.
Chronicle Validation PASS applies to Chronicle's own Entry, schema, and profile conformance.
Neither Chronicle Verification nor Chronicle Validation establishes the substantive correctness of the Certifier certification decision.
Satoshium Certifier remains authoritative for the certification action, determination, package, lifecycle, and status.
Satoshium Atlas remains authoritative for the underlying El Salvador jurisdiction intelligence.
Historical preservation does not independently establish current Certifier state on 2026-09-19.
Eligibility does not establish the eventual Attestor Evaluation Outcome.
exclusions: Re-certification of the Atlas subject by Chronicle.
Independent adjudication by Chronicle of the Certifier certification decision.
Treating Chronicle verification_state verified as verification of substantive certification truth.
Treating Chronicle Validation PASS as Attestor Validation.
Using the 2026-07-05 historical occurrence alone to establish current 2026-09-19 certification state.
Substantive truth conclusions concerning El Salvador.
Automatic inference of a favorable Attestor Evaluation Outcome.
Any inference that Chronicle reference transfers Certifier, Atlas, or Registry authority.
notes: Production Eligibility Record for the first controlled Satoshium Attestor production operation.
Eligibility is separate from Validation and Evaluation Outcome.

The governed input is eligible specifically for Chronicle-owned historical-occurrence, temporal, provenance, and institutional-relationship evidence while source authority remains with the originating institutions.
